arxiv-1811-10165.title: Local intersections of Lagrangian manifolds correspond to catastrophe theory
arxiv-1811-10165.creator: Christian Offen
arxiv-1811-10165.description: Abstract . Two smooth map germs are right-equivalent if and only if they generate two Lagrangian submanifolds in a cotangent bundle which have the same contact with the zero-section. In this paper we provide a reverse direction to this classical result of Golubitsky and Guillemin.

arxiv-2003-11687.title: Common-Knowledge Concept Recognition for SEVA
arxiv-2003-11687.creator: Jitin Krishnan, Patrick Coronado, Hemant Purohit, Huzefa Rangwala
arxiv-2003-11687.description: Abstract We build a common-knowledge concept recognition system for a Systems Engineer’s Virtual Assistant (SEVA) which can be used for downstream tasks such as relation extraction, knowledge graph construction, and question-answering. The problem is formulated as a token classification task similar to named entity extraction.

arxiv-2203-03152.title: A global synchronization theorem for oscillators on a random graph
arxiv-2203-03152.creator: Martin Kassabov, Steven H. Strogatz, Alex Townsend
arxiv-2203-03152.description: Abstract Consider n n identical Kuramoto oscillators on a random graph. Specifically, consider Erdős–Rényi random graphs in which any two oscillators are bidirectionally coupled with unit strength, independently and at random, with probability 0 ≤ p ≤ 1 0\leq p\leq 1 .

arxiv-2208-01566.title: Simplified approach to the magnetic blue shift of Mott gaps
arxiv-2208-01566.creator: Mohsen Hafez-Torbati, Frithjof B. Anders, Götz S. Uhrig
arxiv-2208-01566.description: Abstract The antiferromagnetic ordering in Mott insulators upon lowering the temperature is accompanied by a transfer of the single-particle spectral weight to lower energies and a shift of the Mott gap to higher energies (magnetic blue shift, MBS). The MBS is governed by the double exchange and the exchange mechanisms.

arxiv-2211-01843.title: Semicocycle discontinuities for substitutions and reverse-reading automata Thanks: This work was supported by the EPSRC grant number EP/V007459/1.
arxiv-2211-01843.creator: Gandhar Joshi, Reem Yassawi
arxiv-2211-01843.description: Abstract . In this article we define the semigroup associated to a primitive substitution. We use it to construct a minimal automaton which generates a substitution sequence u in reverse reading. We show, in the case where the substitution has a coincidence, that this automaton completely describes the semicocycle discontinuities of u .

arxiv-2302-03512.title: A Survey on Arabic Named Entity Recognition: Past, Recent Advances, and Future Trends
arxiv-2302-03512.creator: Xiaoye Qu, Yingjie Gu, Qingrong Xia, Zechang Li, Zhefeng Wang, Baoxing Huai
arxiv-2302-03512.description: Abstract As more and more Arabic texts emerged on the Internet, extracting important information from these Arabic texts is especially useful. As a fundamental technology, Named entity recognition (NER) serves as the core component in information extraction technology, while also playing a critical role in many other Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems, such as question answering and knowledge graph building.

arxiv-2312-16250.title: A Comprehensive Study of Object Tracking in Low-Light Environments
arxiv-2312-16250.creator: Anqi Yi, Nantheera Anantrasirichai
arxiv-2312-16250.description: Abstract Accurate object tracking in low-light environments is crucial, particularly in surveillance and ethology applications. However, achieving this is significantly challenging due to the poor quality of captured sequences. Factors such as noise, color imbalance, and low contrast contribute to these challenges. This paper presents a comprehensive study examining the impact of these distortions on automatic object trackers.

arxiv-2404-17167.title: Detectability of axisymmetric magnetic fields from the core to the surface of oscillating post-main sequence stars
arxiv-2404-17167.creator: Shatanik Bhattacharya, Srijan Bharati Das, Lisa Bugnet, Subrata Panda, Shravan M. Hanasoge
arxiv-2404-17167.description: Abstract Magnetic fields in the stellar interiors are key candidates to explain observed core rotation rates inside solar-like stars along their evolution. Recently, asteroseismic estimates of radial magnetic field amplitudes near the hydrogen-burning shell (H-shell) inside about 24 red-giants (RGs) have been obtained by measuring frequency splittings from their power spectra.

arxiv-2407-02210.title: Baryon Acoustic Oscillations analyses with Density-Split Statistics
arxiv-2407-02210.creator: Tengpeng Xu, Yan-Chuan Cai, Yun Chen, Mark Neyrinck, Liang Gao, Qiao Wang
arxiv-2407-02210.description: Abstract Accurate modeling for the evolution of the Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) is essential for using it as a standard ruler to probe cosmology. We explore the non-linearity of the BAO in different environments using the density-split statistics and compare them to the case of the conventional two-point correlation function (2PCF).

arxiv-2504-17830.title: Self–Adjoint Time Operator in a Weighted Energy Space
arxiv-2504-17830.creator: Radmir Kokoulin
arxiv-2504-17830.description: Abstract Abstract We introduce a self-adjoint time operator \widehat{T}_{w}=i\hbar\bigl(\partial_{E}+\tfrac{1}{2}\,\partial_{E}\ln w(E)\bigr)\ on the weighted energy space L^{2}(\mathbb{R},w(E)\,dE) . Under mild conditions on the weight w (positivity, local absolute continuity, and uniform bounds at large |E| ), we prove that \widehat{T}_{w} is essentially self-adjoint.

arxiv-2510-04235.title: Conformal four-point ladder integrals in diverse dimensions and polylogarithms
arxiv-2510-04235.creator: S.E. Derkachov, A.P. Isaev, L.A. Shumilov
arxiv-2510-04235.description: Abstract In the paper, the family of conformal four-point ladder diagrams in arbitrary space-time dimensions is considered. We use the representation obtained via explicit calculation using the operator approach and conformal quantum mechanics to study their properties, such as symmetries, loop and dimensional shift identities.

parkman-pioneers-france.creator: Francis Parkman
parkman-pioneers-france.description: France and England in North America I: the Huguenot and French pioneers — Parkman's opening volume of the great American colonial history.

One of these is the maternal integument that encloses the other two zygotic components, i.e., the diploid embryo and its nurturing annex, the t

pmc-10484422.title: Comparison of survival analysis approaches to modelling age at first sex among youth in Kisesa Tanzania
pmc-10484422.creator: Jacqueline Materu, Eveline T. Konje, Mark Urassa, Milly Marston, Ties Boerma, Jim Todd
pmc-10484422.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundMany studies analyze sexual and reproductive event data using descriptive life tables. Survival analysis has better power to estimate factors associated with age at first sex (AFS), but proportional hazards models may not be right model to use.

pmc-10599067.title: Formation of the mutagenic DNA lesion 1,N2-ethenoguanine induced by heated cooking oil and identification of causative agents
pmc-10599067.creator: Hiroshi Kasai, Kazuaki Kawai
pmc-10599067.description: BackgroundThe DNA-damaging compounds in heated cooking oil were identified as guanosine adducts. Heated vegetable oil was subjected to deep-frying conditions at 170 °C for 45 min, reacted with isopropylidene guanosine (ipG) at pH 7.4, and the resulting compounds were separated by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC).ResultsTwo adducts, 8-hydroxy-ipG and 1,N2-etheno-ipG, were identified in the reaction mixture.

pmc-10604815.title: ClC-1 Chloride Channel: Inputs on the Structure–Function Relationship of Myotonia Congenita-Causing Mutations
pmc-10604815.creator: Oscar Brenes, Michael Pusch, Fernando Morales, Sheng-Nan Wu, Katarína Štroffeková
pmc-10604815.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Myotonia congenita is a hereditary muscle disease mainly characterized by muscle hyperexcitability, which leads to a sustained burst of discharges that correlates with the magnitude and duration of involuntary aftercontractions, muscle stiffness, and hypertrophy. Mutations in the chloride voltage-gated channel 1 (CLCN1) gene that encodes the skeletal muscle chloride channel (ClC-1) are responsible for this disease, which is commonly known as myotonic chloride channelopathy.

pmc-11330133.title: MAPT haplotype-associated transcriptomic changes in progressive supranuclear palsy
pmc-11330133.creator: Hadley W Ressler, Jack Humphrey, Ricardo A Vialle, Bergan Babrowicz, Shrishtee Kandoi, Towfique Raj, Dennis W Dickson, Nilüfer Ertekin-Taner, John F Crary, Kurt Farrell
pmc-11330133.description: Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) is a neurodegenerative movement and cognitive disorder characterized by abnormal accumulation of the microtubule-associated protein tau in the brain. Biochemically, inclusions in PSP are enriched for tau proteoforms with four microtubule-binding domain repeats (4R), an isoform that arises from alternative tau pre-mRNA splicing.

pmc-12451549.title: Formal and informal mental health support in young adults with recurrently depressed parents
pmc-12451549.creator: Rhys Bevan-Jones, Bryony Weavers, Tessa Lomax, Emma Meilak, Olga Eyre, Victoria Powell, Becky Mars, Frances Rice
pmc-12451549.description: BackgroundA family history of mental illness, particularly parental depression, is a risk factor for mental health difficulties in young people, with this heightened risk extending into adulthood. Evidence suggests low rates of formal mental health support in children/adolescents with depressed parents, but it is unknown whether this pattern persists into adulthood and applies to informal support.

pmc-12568142.title: The Elias University Hospital Approach: A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV—Distal Lower Limb Muscles
pmc-12568142.creator: Marius Nicolae Popescu, Claudiu Căpeț, Cristina Popescu, Mihai Berteanu
pmc-12568142.description: Spasticity of the distal lower limb substantially impairs stance, gait, and quality of life in patients with upper motor neuron lesions. Although ultrasound-guided botulinum toxin A (BoNT-A) injections are increasingly employed, structured, muscle-specific visual guidance for the distal lower limb remains limited.

pmc-12615886.title: Extent of reoperation predicts survival in recurrent IDH-wildtype glioblastoma based on institutional data and individual patient data meta analysis
pmc-12615886.creator: Alim Emre Basaran, Ann-Catalin Wellkisch, Erdem Güresir, Johannes Wach
pmc-12615886.description: BackgroundGlioblastoma (GB) is the most aggressive brain tumor, characterized by rapid progression and poor prognosis. Despite initial multimodal treatment options, therapeutic options become more limited upon recurrence. Consequently, recurrent IDH-wildtype GB is associated with poor survival outcomes, with limited data to guide optimal therapeutic strategies.

pmc-12652256.title: Therapeutic Potential of Baicalein in Endometrial Cancer: Suppression of mTOR Signaling and Synergy with Metformin
pmc-12652256.creator: Alison L Dumitriu, Wei Wen, Jin Yan, Quanhua Xing, Finn E Ro, Ernest S Han, John H Yim, Ana-Maria Vlase
pmc-12652256.description: Baicalein, a natural flavonoid derived from traditional medicinal herbs, has demonstrated anticancer activity in various malignancies, but its role in endometrial cancer remains largely unexplored. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic potential of baicalein, alone and in combination with metformin, in human endometrial cancer cells.

pmc-12655330.title: Valorization of Olive Leaf Extract via Tailored Liposomal Carriers: Comparative Analysis of Physicochemical Features, Antioxidant Capacity, and Stability
pmc-12655330.creator: Jovan Baljak, Dragana Dekanski, Andrea Pirković, Ninoslav Mitić, Aleksandar Rašković, Nebojša Kladar, Aleksandra A Jovanović, Annalisa Santucci
pmc-12655330.description: Background/Objectives: Olive leaf (Olea europaea L.), a by-product of olive oil production, is rich in bioactive phenolics but limited in application due to poor solubility and stability. To improve their bioavailability, this study presents a comparative encapsulation strategy using three phospholipid-based liposomal systems (AL, PG90, and PH90) loaded with ethanolic olive leaf extract.
